prompt.content:
Customers report incorrect invoices when orders include products fulfilled
in different jurisdictions. Some exempt purchases are taxed, and totals also
look inconsistent for larger quantities and small-value purchases. Customers
also report missing repeated products and subtotals that do not reconcile
with the displayed lines.

Investigate the billing system, determine the causes, and repair its calculation
implementation. Preserve legitimate business records and unrelated behavior.
Your repair must work beyond the visible customer orders.

Use inspect_business to review records and the business/repair contract,
read_calculator to inspect the implementation, calculate_cart to reproduce
invoices, and replace_calculator to apply your repair. Only the persisted
calculation source is graded; your final explanation is not executable and
does not affect the score. All jurisdictions and rules are fictional.
